title: A Census on the Plains of Moab
description: Moses and the priest Eleazar conduct a new census of all men twenty years old and older who are able to go to war, on the plains of Moab by the Jordan near Jericho. The count provides the basis for dividing the land as an inheritance among the tribes by casting lots, and marks that the entire generation from Sinai has died in the wilderness, except for Caleb and Joshua.
